learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise to solve design tasks for simple and moderately complex machines.

syllabus_topics: Machine Elements 1: Important components (e.g., shafts and rolling bearings) for simple to moderately complex machines; selection, design, and functional installation of these components; calculation methods to dimension components and check for strength and service life.
Design Theory 1: Systematic approach to solving complex technical problems based on VDI guideline 2221 ff, using examples from machine design.

assessment_methods.method: graded written exam (120 min) for MABB241
graded written exam (120 min) for MABB242

assessment_rules: The graded written exam has a duration of 120 minutes. The weighting of the exam performance is MABB241:MABB242 = 2:1.
bibliography: Wittel, H. et al.: Roloff/Matek Maschinenelemente – Normung, Berechnung, Gestaltung. Springer 2017
Pahl, G.; Beitz, W.: Konstruktionslehre – Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung. Springer 2013
